phase: 13 -- the official destination-marketing roster (The Beaches of Fort Myers & Sanibel, the Lee County Visitor & Convention Bureau), measured first
the_bureau_was_measured: Every bureau was probed before it was read; the platform each one runs is recorded, never assumed.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Only lodging-typed partners are kept; the census decides what each row is and where it is.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: No bureau amenity chip or 'pet-friendly hotels' page is read, stored or published.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: The row's own postal code does -- and decides its municipality.

bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitflorida.com: the state tourism office; links to the county bureaus -- recorded, not walked
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.fortmyersbeachchamber.org / capecoral.ne: answered this plain client with a TLS refusal (curl exit 35) on 2026-10-08 -- measured, not walked; the county bureau carries their lodging members
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.sanibel-captiva.org: the Sanibel & Captiva Islands Chamber; a 301 to its bare host -- measured, not walked

lee-county-vcb.platform: Drupal 10 on Pantheon; the bureau's own public OpenSearch proxy, filtered to its own lodging categories (Places to Stay / Meeting Venues & Hotels), then each lodging listing's own bureau page for its structured premises
